name: Natsu Matsuri de Deatta Shoujo Kanade
original_name: 夏祭りで出会った少女 かなで
source:
A girl in a summer kimono with no panties wants to play!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE145949.html]DLsite English[/url]]
